name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qis
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3)]. Build the cost and mixer layers manually, optimize with scipy, and print the best cut found. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
